description_en: Sets the cloud storage image lifecycle for an IPC device

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If the public instance does not have an ID value, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。

parameters.description_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.

You can view the information about all products under the current account on the **Products** page in the IoT Platform console, or call [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) to query the information.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

parameters.description_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) of IoT Platform to query the device ID.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is the unique identifier of a device and corresponds to the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** on a one-to-one basis. If you specify **IotId** together with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>
parameters.description_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>
